frontmatter.name: implementer
frontmatter.description: Implements an approved plan with minimal changes, then runs prek hooks, lint and typecheck. Does not write tests.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Approved plan or task to implement

frontmatter.name: orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Understands the need, then orchestrates planner, implementer, test-writer, reviewer and ui-ux-controller. Read-only itself; asks approval before implementation.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Feature, bug or task to deliver end to end

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Read-only code review. Checks correctness, security (OWASP, Supabase RLS), offline-sync safety, tests and rule compliance. Reports a severity table.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Diff, PR number or files to review

frontmatter.name: test-writer
frontmatter.description: Writes and runs unit, Storybook and Playwright e2e tests. Edits test and story files only.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Target file, behavior or report to cover

frontmatter.name: ui-ux-controller
frontmatter.description: Read-only UI/UX audit. Checks theme, spacing, mobile-first, Tailwind/daisyUI usage and cross-view consistency; advises on compatible UI tools and MCP.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Scope to audit (whole app, a view, a component)

frontmatter.name: add-tests
